pages.caption: ВЕНТ ЦИСТЕРН ГРЯЗНОГО МАСЛА — "vent of the dirty oil tanks": the air pipe of the tank that holds used engine oil.
the same label's stencil, cut from a crew's effects declaration (what each sailor brought aboard).
VENT. NAVIGATION BRIDGE — air vent for the bridge, the ship's command room.
ВЕНТ. ДИЗЕЛЬ ГЕНЕРАТОРНАЯ — vent of the diesel generator room, where the ship makes its electricity.
ВЕНТ. АГРЕГАТНАЯ / VENT. AGREGAT ROOM — vent of the machinery room. "agregat" is a russian word left in the english.
ВЕНТ. ДИЗ-ГЕНЕР… — diesel generator vent, the stencil, curved and torn off.
the diesel generator vent sprayed black.
VENT OF TANKS OF DIRTY OIL — the stencil. the O in "oil" is a solid dot.
VENT OF TANKS OF DIRTY OIL sprayed black.
ВЕНТ СТОЛОВАЯ ЭКИПАЖА — "vent, crew mess room": where the crew ate. the stencil.
the crew mess vent sprayed white.
ЖИЛЫЕ ПОМЕЩЕНИЯ — "living quarters": the vent for the cabins. sprayed.
SUPPLY ENG. / ПРИТОЧНЫЙ МЕХ… — the fan that pushes fresh air into the engine room.
a torn strip of a vent stencil, cut from a certificate of the ship's registry.
…ANNEL — the end of a word, torn off. maybe "channel", maybe a misspelled "panel".
VENT CO2 — vent of the CO2 room, where the fire-fighting gas is stored.
